gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-newa: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with every stroke held to one measured thickness. Noto Sans Newa takes over below with a wide-mouthed e and tall bowls, giving that rigid heading something softer to lean on.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads tall, with terminals held far from the stroke. Megrim bends its angular heading letters like tubing, and the towering body below gives the whole pairing an upward, futuristic lean.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads bold, since its lowercase bodies run so tall. Megrim skims along on strokes that never change weight, while Noto Sans Ogham does the steadier work of keeping small text open and legible.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its a, e and s large and open. Megrim is the showpiece, angular and futuristic in a single-width stroke, while the sans body quietly holds up at tiny sizes.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Ruler-and-compass lines define Megrim. Megrim does angular, futuristic display best, while Noto Sans Old Persian handles the reading with tall, open counters that breathe into the white space.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Megrim runs one track width, like a neon sign tube. Beneath it, Noto Sans Old Sogdian stands nearly cap-tall in its lowercase and stays crisp when shrunk, which keeps the whole pairing sharp.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Contemporary and approachable, with a futuristic edge. Make Megrim small and its angular drama fades, while Noto Sans Oriya keeps generous curve gaps and near-capital lowercase at any size.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-osage: Inflated curves meet angular lines, all of it quite approachable. Megrim does the sharp display work, its round letters built like its straight ones, while Noto Sans Osage fills the line with sweeping bowls.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Futuristic from the first glance, Megrim draws letters as if with a marker tip. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, with a high-set x-height and gapped rounds, gives the pairing a crisp, modern strength.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Hard-edged and futuristic, Megrim gives crossbars the same weight as stems, so every heading looks cut from one bent line. Noto Sans Palmyrene reads compact and clean, curves stopping short.
